experimental_scope: Reduced independently motivated source-interface fixtures. Finite row coverage pertains only to the frozen fixture set, not full upstream software or real-world intent.
license: Research-only; no automatic code write, deployment or owner authority

cases.contract: Mapping-key identity requires exact Unicode source key, including characters after embedded NUL; the result must retain precisely the distinctions between different complete keys.
cases.old_description: A legacy C-style string boundary displays only the prefix before the first NUL.
cases.notes: Finite reduced model of the observed L4YAML FFI loss; not a rerun of the upstream parser.

cases.contract: An exported row's meaningful state identity includes its coordinate frame as well as the ordered numeric coordinates. Retain exactly frame-plus-coordinates identity, not an incidental row ID.
cases.old_description: Old exported representation keeps coordinates but omits frame context.
cases.fields: coords: 3 finite numeric components; frame: string
cases.notes: Finite abstract frame-metadata model, not native Nyx serialization.

cases.contract: The protected Boolean alert is true exactly if the absolute temperature change against the prior reading of the same cell exceeds 5 units. Changes to other cells' history must not affect this alert.
cases.old_description: Old observer compares current cell value against an unrelated other-cell prior reading.
cases.fields: current: integer; previous_same_cell: integer; previous_other_cell: integer
cases.notes: Finite modeled adaptation of CySat published same-cell requirement; not a reproduced source-native C2PO run.

cases.contract: From the stated numeric requirement, the alarm is true exactly when temperature < 120 OR temperature > 180, interpreted mathematically before numeric narrowing. Source field is a signed 8-bit integer in [-128,127].
cases.old_description: Original typed-C demonstration effectively compares the upper bound with wrapped signed Int8 value -76 instead of 180.
cases.notes: Faithful finite arithmetic abstraction of a source-pinned Ogma demo mismatch; not a flight requirement.

cases.contract: Identity is Python Unicode casefold equivalence (not lowercase and not ASCII diacritic-stripping). Different casefold values must remain distinct, while equal casefold values must merge.
cases.old_description: Old observation strips non-ASCII diacritics and non-ASCII characters and lowercases, thereby collapsing some distinct casefold values.
cases.notes: Intentional out-of-grammar challenge: the safe finite interpreter does not expose Unicode casefold or string methods.

cases.contract: Protect only parity of x in the complete declared finite domain {0..7}.
cases.notes: Structural positive control: no LLM needed.

cases.contract: Protect full integer identity on an unbounded domain; only three distinct states have been inspected.
cases.old_description: Observed identity agrees on the sampled states, without complete domain coverage.
cases.notes: UNKNOWN control: no observed collision does not imply sufficiency on an unbounded domain.

cases.contract: A positional signal monitor receives columns after a runtime header reorder, but no owner-authored policy says whether reorders must be rejected, remapped or forbidden.
cases.old_description: Old monitor uses compile-time positional signal indices.
cases.fields: header: list of signal names; samples: list of values
cases.notes: Authority control: do not manufacture a semantic oracle.

cases.contract: An intended permission decision depends on hidden owner intent not present in any available source field. The same public evidence can correspond to opposite owner decisions.
cases.old_description: Only available source field is an identical public packet, with no owner decision channel.
cases.fields: packet: the only available public value
cases.notes: Information-theoretic no-go: no lawful source-only expression can resolve the collision.
